title: Zanesville metal seen moving under a microscope

tellings.quote: But I've seen some of it in real time on a l on the microscope and what I saw there were different types and but it was moving the one piece

plain: Metal said to come from an unexplained source in Zanesville, Ohio, was seen moving under a microscope. Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs appear around him and whom the show describes as studied by NASA, tells Michels he watched it in real time: there were different types of material, and one piece was moving. A moving metal would suggest it is not ordinary manufactured material.
